ravi: Noticing tile-render stutter on canary when zooming large dashboards. Freeze ~250-600ms, reproducible. zoe: saw traces too, flamegraph: main pinned in `deserializeTile` and `drawTile`. https://perf.redwood/fg/1751239999 matt: any recent routing/quota changes? ida: yes, two changes yesterday: prefetch fanout set to `route_by_tenant` and quota.bucket.size lowered from 300->120. Also a splitpoint change merged `binary-decode` into main. (quoted config) ```
# 2026-03-25
prefetch:
  fanout: route_by_tenant
quota:
  bucket:
    size: 120
bundle:
  splitpoints:
    binary-decode: merged_into_main
``` ops-bot: "canary deploy detected: prefetch.fanout=route_by_tenant, quota.bucket.size=120, splitpoint binary-decode merged" zoe: outcome: more duplicate prefetches per session -> more tile bytes decoded on main -> stalls. ravi: quick mitigation ideas: 1) flip prefetch.fanout back to `global` in canary 2) enable `telemetry.defer_decode=true` to offload decoding 3) revert quota bucket size to 300 for canary 4) plan worker-shared chunk for binary-decode. matt: I can flip prefetch and quota now. ops-bot: "prefetch.fanout set to global in eu-canary at 1751240012" ops-bot: "quota.bucket.size set to 300 in eu-canary at 1751240015" ida: I enabled `telemetry.defer_decode=true` in canary. ops-bot: "feature toggle telemetry.defer_decode=true for eu-canary at 1751240020" zoe: after toggles, median stalls drop to ~50-120ms. Good sign. ravi: follow-ups: - ENG-PLAT-980: split binary-decode into worker-shared chunk - ENG-PLAT-981: add CI perf gate for main_chunk parse_time and bundle delta - ENG-PLAT-982: router dedupe to avoid identical prefetches across tenant routes - instrument metrics: tile_decode_ms, prefetch_duplicate_rate, kvcache_eviction_rate zoe: also propose a canary guard: if main_thread.decode_ms > 150ms sustained for 60s, auto-pause prefetch for that region. matt: I'll open the tickets and add the canary alert. ravi: thanks all
